content.text: You hold the library design. Read back the current design before we continue.
I hold library. Patrons renew loans without staff intervention. Borrowing charges stop when the library receives the returned book. These meanings are settled; no cut is in flight.
Keep the return boundary distinct from renewal.
Receipt ends borrowing charges; renewal extends an existing loan without requiring staff.
Do borrowing charges continue after the library receives a returned book? Nothing remains for anyone once this meaning question is settled.
